subhead: Deep, permanent reference hubs for the engines and systems Land Rover owners research most – not blog posts, not one-off articles. Every guide is built on real UK enquiry data and JLR-specific expertise.

items.title: TDV6 Knowledge Centre
items.text: Every variant, every failure, every generation it was fitted to – the 2.7 and 3.0 TDV6/SDV6 complete guide.

items.title: SDV6 Knowledge Centre
items.text: The 3.0 V6 diesel's full ownership profile – performance, reliability, and known issues.

items.title: Ingenium Knowledge Centre
items.text: Petrol vs diesel reliability, pre- and post-2019 changes, and what to look for when buying.

items.title: SDV8 Knowledge Centre
items.text: The 4.4 V8 diesel's reliability record and running costs – the most durable engine in the range.

items.title: Air Suspension Knowledge Centre
items.text: Common faults, compressor failure, replacement costs, and how to diagnose EAS issues.

items.title: Terrain Response Systems
items.text: What goes wrong, what it costs to fix, and how to maintain JLR's advanced 4x4 system.

items.title: ZF Gearbox Problems
items.text: The 8-speed automatic's known issues across JLR's range – mechatronic, torque converter, and more.

items.title: Transfer Box & Differential Problems
items.text: 4x4 system faults by model and generation – ATC300/400 chain stretch, diff whine, and UJ failures.
